name: unmess
title: unmess.io
payoff: AI for chores, starting with shopping
shortDescription: unmess is a personal AI tool designed to simplify daily chores, starting with shopping. It helps users manage grocery shopping by automatically generating purchase lists based on personal preferences, dietary needs, and past purchases. For example, if you encounter dust, unmess suggests a self-care session to mitigate its effects. It also assists in fashion shopping by finding or inspiring new purchases based on items you see.
pros: Saves time on routine shopping tasks
Personalizes shopping experience based on user preferences
Offers self-care recommendations based on environmental factors
cons: Limited to shopping and self-care tasks
Dependence on accurate user data input
Potential privacy concerns with data handling
